  • Method Details

    • drawRotatedText

      public static void drawRotatedText(Graphics2D g2, Point cp, String s, Font font, Color tcolor, double theta, int align)
      Draws rotated multi-line text with specified alignment.

      This method creates its own Graphics2D copy so that the translate/rotate transforms and the dispose() call never affect the caller's context. The original g2 is left completely unmodified.

      Parameters:
      g2 - the Graphics context (never modified or disposed)
      cp - the center point for the text block and the rotation pivot
      s - the text to draw (may contain newlines)
      font - the font to use
      tcolor - the text color
      theta - the rotation angle in degrees
      align - Use SwingConstants.LEFT, CENTER, or RIGHT

    • textBounds

      public static Rectangle textBounds(String text, FontMetrics fm, int leftMargin, int rightMargin, int topMargin, int bottomMargin, float lineSpacing)
      Calculate the bounding rectangle for a block of text with given margins and line spacing.
      Parameters:
      text - the text content which can contain multiple lines
      fm - the FontMetrics object for measuring text
      leftMargin - the left margin in pixels
      rightMargin - the right margin in pixels
      topMargin - the top margin in pixels
      bottomMargin - the bottom margin in pixels
      lineSpacing - the line spacing factor (1.0 = normal, >1.0 = more space)
      Returns:
      the bounding Rectangle for the text block
